answer: Place left at the beginning and right at the end. Swap their values and move both pointers inward until they meet. Time O(n), extra space O(1).
Compare the characters at left and right. If they differ, it is not a palindrome. Otherwise move both pointers inward.
Start at both ends. If the sum is too small, move left forward. If it is too large, move right backward. This works because the array is sorted.
Use one pointer for the position of the next unique value and another to scan the array. Copy a value only when it differs from the previous unique value.
Use one pointer to scan the array and another to indicate where the next non-zero value belongs. This avoids creating another array.
Calculate the first window sum once. When the window moves, subtract the element leaving the window and add the new element entering it. Time O(n).
Maintain a running sum for a window of size k. Each movement requires one subtraction and one addition rather than summing the complete window again.
Maintain a queue of indices of negative elements. Remove indices that leave the window and use the front of the queue as the first negative value.
Expand the right side until the sum reaches the target. Then repeatedly move the left side inward while the condition remains true, recording the smallest window.
Expand the right pointer while tracking characters in the current window. When a duplicate appears, move the left boundary beyond the previous occurrence.
Maintain a window containing at most one zero. Expand right normally and move left whenever the window contains more than one zero.
Maintain character frequencies in the current window. Expand right and shrink from the left whenever the number of distinct characters becomes greater than k.
Use a window equal to the pattern length and maintain character frequencies. A window is an anagram when its required character counts match those of the pattern.
Start with pointers at both ends. Calculate the area, record the maximum, and move the pointer at the shorter line inward because keeping the shorter line cannot improve the area by reducing width.
Expand the right boundary until all required characters are present. Then shrink the left boundary as much as possible while the window remains valid. Record the smallest valid window.
